verdict.rationale: Poly's docs describe a built-in Poly agent you can ask to summarize, explain, edit files, and automate tasks such as organizing a folder. The agent handles multi-step tasks (reading, searching, writing, organizing) in a single request, writes and edits files directly in your storage, and can spawn subagents to delegate and track work. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent performs delegated tasks as documented.
